layers.message: Record implementation review of CSV export
Save final review progress before scope change
Retire export access condition and add operations guide condition
Update export design coverage for revised scope
Reconcile export plan with revised scope

graderOnly: src/, test/, packages/, package.json, and pnpm-lock.yaml are identical at HEAD to the commit 'Record verification of CSV export' that holds the COMPLETE report; since then only workflow records, docs/usage.md, and README.md changed.
AC-001 evidence remains valid: pnpm --filter export test (24 passed) and pnpm --filter export test:integration (2 passed) still pass on the unchanged code.
AC-002 is retired. test/export-access.test.ts (three scenarios written for AC-002) still passes and remains a reusable project test, but it is not current acceptance coverage.
No operations guide exists in the repository; AC-004 depends entirely on Documenter. docs/usage.md's export section does not describe the export folder, retention, or same-second replacement.
Before the run the full check reports exactly one problem: the COMPLETE verification report does not account for AC-004. The turn-end (stop hook) check reports none.

The implementation review report and the documentation record are COMPLETE, predate the scope revision, and do not mention AC-004; they belong to Reviewer and Documenter. Scoper's route (RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL) does not rerun documentation.
A correct handoff is FORWARD from TESTING to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION with recovery frame 1 kept unchanged (RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, ResumeAt REVIEWING_FINAL).

notes: Built on export-testing (cycle export-20260924T090000Z-a7f3c1d2 at TESTING with correct code). Layers: 50 commits Tester-owned test/export-access.test.ts (anonymous 401, viewer 403, editor 403, no folder created). 52 commits the VERIFY report, COMPLETE, FULL/NONE, AC-001 and AC-002 verified, citing blobs of the original scope/design/plan/context and the implementation commits; STATE to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION. 55 implementation review COMPLETE, no findings; STATE to DOCUMENTING. 60 adds an Exporting records section to docs/usage.md and a README layout line (no folder, retention, or overwrite details). 62 documentation record COMPLETE; STATE to REVIEWING_FINAL. 65 final review IN_PROGRESS (paused) and USER_REWORK from REVIEWING_FINAL to SCOPING with FailureType SCOPING, Request updated, frame 1 pushed. 70 Scoper retires AC-002 (user moved export access rules to separate work; existing check left as is) and AC-003 (a user-guide draft replaced in the same pass, which explains why the new ID is AC-004), adds AC-004 operations guide; sets RerunThrough REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION and forwards to ARCHITECTING. 75 Architect: AC-004 no architectural impact, AC-002 coverage removed; forward to DEVELOPING. 80 Developer bookkeeping rerun: DEV-003 acceptance reference reconciled to AC-001, plan stays COMPLETE, no code change; FORWARD DEVELOPING to TESTING. Code and tests unchanged since the report. expectCheck is ok:false with exactly one problem (the COMPLETE report does not account for AC-004), which is the Tester-owned work the case is about; the turn-end check passes. After a correct run (REVERIFY, AC-001 retained, AC-004 pending Documenter, report COMPLETE, FORWARD to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION keeping the frame) the turn-end check still passes.
